name: USDTStakingContract28 public tokenAllowAll()
summary: tokenAllowAll(token, spender) was public with no owner check, so the attacker had the staking contract approve them for unlimited USDT and then transferred out the whole deposit balance.
notes: Entire preexisting staking balance transferred to attacker, valued at USDT par. No campaign input or recovery adjustment; gas costs do not reduce gross loss.
